title: Help
description: Everything here stays on this device.
introTitle: Plan your feed before it goes live

introSteps.add: Add images to the tray, or drop them anywhere on the window.
introSteps.arrange: Drag them into the grid. Drop on a cell to swap, or near its edge to insert.
introSteps.preview: Use the phone button to see how the feed will look.

actions.pickUp: Pick up or drop the focused image
actions.move: Move the image you picked up
actions.insert: Insert instead of swap, while dragging

name: Name
profileNote: Shown in the phone preview. It stays in this browser.
storageNote: Your images are kept in this browser and never leave it until you schedule a post.
